tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a Pool Pro Florida service lead in Pool Founder when a customer is interested in service but is not yet booking an appointment. Do not call this before book_appointment for the same inquiry because a successful Cal.com booking creates the Pool Founder lead through the booking webhook.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Get real Cal.com appointment availability for Pool Pro Florida. Use date-only YYYY-MM-DD values. Use this when a customer wants to schedule a pool consultation or service appointment.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed Pool Pro Florida appointment through Cal.com after the customer has selected an available time.
